findings.claim: Google Play requires new mobile apps and updates submitted from 2026-08-31 to target Android 16 / API 36 or higher.
Android's current tool matrix lists API 36 minimum AGP 8.9.1, while the AGP 8.9 release note still states max API 35. AGP 8.10 explicitly supports API 36 and requires Gradle 8.11.1.
Since 2026-04-28 App Store Connect uploads must be built with Xcode 26 or later using an iOS 26-family SDK.
GitHub Actions exposes macos-26 runners and the current macOS 26 runner toolset includes Xcode 26.x.
The official sing-box Android client uses Android VpnService for unprivileged TUN; the sing-box Apple build produces a Libbox.xcframework for Apple targets.

Recent upstream Android reports include foreground-service startup failures on Android 16/Quick Settings flows, demonstrating device/lifecycle validation remains necessary beyond desktop or emulator core tests.

decision.androidToolchain: compileSdk=36; targetSdk=36; AGP=8.10.1; Gradle=8.11.1; Build Tools=35.0.0
decision.iosToolchain: macos-26 hosted runner with explicit Xcode>=26 and iOS simulator SDK>=26 guard
decision.mobileForwarding: Do not add a new forwarding core or bind libbox in this change set.
rationale: The accepted mobile DoD is fail-closed lifecycle/toolchain validation, not unproven production forwarding.

A mature comparable implementation uses a dedicated native core binding; reproducing that inside a finalization patch would substantially expand dependency, lifecycle, licensing and device-validation surface.
The project root has no general project license file, while comparable sing-box components are GPL-licensed; introducing them requires a separate explicit licensing/architecture decision.
Keeping TUN establishment disabled until a real core is linked prevents false VPN success and provides the same safety outcome with lower risk.

rejected.reason: No longer submission-ready for normal Google Play mobile app updates as of current date.
Primary documentation is internally inconsistent around AGP 8.9 API-36 support; 8.10.x provides an explicit API-36 support statement.
Unnecessary major toolchain/API migration for the required API-36 outcome.
High-surface architecture/licensing/device-runtime change not required to close the current fail-closed mobile gate.

currentCandidate.ios: macos-26 + Xcode/iOS26 guards / NEPacketTunnelProvider fail-closed core-not-linked
